Regression test: "unlicensed" as an ordinary word

Expected popup result: Missing — this notice grants no rights and names no license at all.

This used to be misclassified as Unlicense (mapped to the publicDomain category), because license-db.js's NAME_TO_SPDX pattern for the Unlicense was a bare, unanchored /unlicense/ regex, which matched "unlicensed" as a substring. That was security-relevant: the default allowed-categories list includes publicDomain, so with blocking enabled this script would have been let through even though it explicitly grants no rights. The pattern now uses a negative lookahead, /unlicense(?!d)/, so it no longer matches "unlicensed". This fixture is kept as a regression test for that fix.
